scripts.build:nuxt:dependencies: pnpm --filter @eve-space/platform-module-contract build && pnpm --filter @eve-space/platform-module-nuxt build && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts nuxt build
scripts.quality:sonar: pnpm test:frontend:coverage && pnpm test:api:coverage && pnpm test:modules:coverage && pnpm test:redis && pnpm sonar
scripts.lint: oxlint . && pnpm registry:check && node scripts/verify-esi-egress.mjs && tsx scripts/verify-module-boundaries.ts && tsx scripts/verify-nuxt-module-boundaries.ts
scripts.test:frontend: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.ui.config.ts
scripts.test:frontend:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true })" && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage && vitest run --config vitest.ui.config.ts --coverage
scripts.test:modules: pnpm --filter @eve-space/platform-module-nuxt test && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts server test && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts nuxt test
scripts.test:modules:coverage: pnpm --filter @eve-space/platform-module-nuxt test:coverage && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts server test:coverage && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts nuxt test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.output', { recursive: true, force: true })" && nuxt build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:nuxt: pnpm build:nuxt:dependencies && pnpm --filter @eve-space/platform-module-nuxt typecheck && tsx scripts/run-installed-module-package-script.ts nuxt typecheck && nuxt typecheck
scripts.postinstall: pnpm build:nuxt:dependencies && nuxt prepare && lefthook install
